title: [3.1.0.3] AAPS uploads ecarbs (carbs spread over time) to NS as one time event
body:
I inputed 12 grams of carbs spread over one hour starting 11:37  at around 10:45. In NS it showed up as one bolus of 12 grams. I thought I made a mistake, I deleted it in AAPS, NS and Xdrip and entered it again around 11:08 (see last screenshot) but the results were similar. 

Before this bug, AAPS would create 4 treatments at 15 minute intervals of 3 grams each. It still shows up as such in AAPS but not in the treatments tab, nor on NS.
